name: copywriting-assistant-task-poc
description: E-commerce copywriting assistant — root scripts + frontend ESLint gate

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && (cd backend && PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" uv sync)
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend,warm -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run warm:next"
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host localhost --port 5001
scripts.test: cd backend && PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" uv run pytest -q
scripts.test:workers: cd backend && PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" uv run pytest -q -n
scripts.test:integration: cd backend && PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" uv run pytest -m integration -q
scripts.test:e2e: cd backend && PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" uv run pytest -m integration tests/test_live_e2e_imba_seat.py -q -s --timeout=180
scripts.quality: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
